O-Tremolo by Ouaricon Audio
Version 1.4.1

ABOUT O-Tremolo

A tremolo effect plugin featuring a botanical aesthetic inspired by vintage herbarium illustrations. Provides classic amplitude modulation with 6 waveform types, smoothing control, tempo sync, and stereo panning capabilities.

FEATURES

- 6 LFO waveform types (Sine, Triangle, Phasor, Noise, Square, Pulse)
- Tempo Sync locks to DAW BPM with musical note divisions
- Pan Sync for stereo width modulation (L/R 180 degree phase offset)
- One-pole lowpass smoothing filter for click-free modulation
- 10 factory presets (Default, Slow Pulse, Fast Chop, Auto-Pan, Subtle, Helicopter, Vintage Amp, Synced Sidechain, Wide Stereo, Glitch)
- WebView UI with vintage botanical + Bakelite Radio aesthetic

PARAMETERS

1. Speed (0.1-20.0 Hz, default 4.5 Hz) - Tremolo rate. Shows Hz or musical divisions.
2. Depth (0-100%, default 75%) - Modulation intensity.
3. Waveform (Sine/Triangle/Phasor/Noise/Square/Pulse) - Modulation shape.
4. Smoothing (0-100%, default 30%) - Waveform curve softness.
5. Pan Sync (On/Off) - Stereo width modulation with L/R phase offset.
6. Tempo Sync (On/Off) - Lock rate to DAW tempo.

INSTALLATION LOCATION

After installation, O-Tremolo will be available in:
  C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\O-Tremolo.vst3

Note: Windows supports VST3 format only (no AU).

SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS

- Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
- Compatible DAW with VST3 support

DAW SETUP

Ableton Live:
  Options > Preferences > Plug-ins > enable "Use VST3 Plug-in System Folder"
  Rescan plugins or restart Ableton

FL Studio:
  Options > Manage Plugins > click "Find plugins" or "Start scan"
  The standard VST3 path is scanned automatically

Reaper:
  Options > Preferences > VST > Add path: C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3
  Click "Re-scan" or restart Reaper

Bitwig Studio:
  Settings > Plug-ins > enable "VST3" and scan
  The standard VST3 path is scanned automatically

Studio One:
  Studio One > Options > Locations > VST Plug-ins
  Add path if needed: C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3
  Rescan from Instruments/Effects browser

UNINSTALL

To remove O-Tremolo:
  1. Open Settings > Apps > Installed apps (or Control Panel > Programs and Features)
  2. Search for "O-Tremolo VST3 by Ouaricon Audio"
  3. Click Uninstall and follow the prompts

Alternatively, manually delete:
  C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\O-Tremolo.vst3
Then rescan plugins in your DAW.

SUPPORT

Visit https://ouaricon.audio for support and more plugins.

Enjoy making music with O-Tremolo!
